meta.name: The Impossible Heir
meta.description: An ambitious boy grows up and joins an intense war of desires to become a star of his own.

videos.title: Fate
videos.overview: Taeoh, Inha, and Hyewon run towards the same desire. They are drawn to one another by fate.

videos.title: Beginning
videos.overview: An ambitious boy grows up and joins an intense war of desires to become a star of his own

videos.title: Desirers
videos.overview: Taeoh ousts Seongju from the Co-prosperity Cooperation Center and Chairman Kang collapses.

videos.title: Thrill
videos.overview: Taeoh begins a dangerous game to make Inha's presence known to the world.

videos.title: Monster
videos.overview: The difference between Tae Oh and In Ha is revealed, and a fatal blow is aimed at Tae Oh.

videos.title: Weakness
videos.overview: Tae Oh chases the culprit who tried to kill him and faces impending doom.

videos.title: Reality
videos.overview: Tae Oh is arrested as a murder suspect. Dark shadows lurk around him with his memories missing.

videos.title: Scream
videos.overview: Tae Oh has been sentenced to death but he does not stop seeking the truth to prove his innocence. The heinous nature hidden within a particular person shocks everyone.

meta.slogan: I want it, I need it, I'll take it.
